schedule.concept_assignment: 80 of every 100 base rows select the first 20 percent of domain concepts; remaining rows select the other 80 percent; every 97th base row uses concept zero
schedule.person_assignment: four of every five base rows select the first 20 percent of people; remaining rows select all people
schedule.duplicates: each physical row with zero-based index99 modulo100 repeats the preceding complete row including its source ID
schedule.observation_periods: people ending in0 have none; ending in1 have an overlapping interval; ending in2 have an adjacent interval; ending in3 have an additional invalid interval
schedule.measurement: missing numeric values at base index0 modulo10; explicit operator at base index3 modulo20; 16 possible known units plus null,zero,unknown; finite and non-finite values retained
